name: SMB Transaction & Communication Broker
description: Agent-callable service for the long tail of small businesses. Discover, verify, communicate, schedule, transact — all with built-in TCPA/GDPR/CASL compliance and idempotent semantics.

skills.name: Find Business
skills.description: Given criteria (vertical, location, capability, price band, availability window), return ranked candidate SMBs from the verified supply network. Returns only curated, verified, transactable businesses — not raw directory results.

skills.name: Verify Business
skills.description: Confirm that an SMB is real, currently operating, and capable of the requested service. Performs a live capability probe against the business's channel.

skills.name: Send Message
skills.description: Send an outbound message to an SMB or its customer across channels (SMS, email, chat, voice, push). Channel is abstracted — you specify intent and recipient; the service selects and falls back across channels.

skills.name: Capture Lead
skills.description: Structured intake of a prospect into an SMB's funnel with validation, enrichment hooks, and deduplication. Inserts into the SMB's CRM or direct-booking pipeline if available.

skills.name: Schedule Appointment
skills.description: Availability lookup, hold, confirm, reschedule, or cancel appointments with an SMB. Routes through the SMB's native booking system if available, falls back to voice AI or web form.

skills.name: Send Transactional Confirmation
skills.description: Idempotent transactional messages: OTPs, booking confirmations, payment receipts, cancellation notices. Guaranteed delivery via redundant channels.

skills.name: Handle Inbound
skills.description: Receive, classify, and route inbound messages on behalf of an SMB. Classifies intent (booking request, cancellation, inquiry, complaint), enriches with context, and routes to the appropriate handler or escalation path.

skills.name: Escalate To Human
skills.description: Hand off an in-flight task to a human operator with a full context bundle: transcript, prior actions, identifiers, and a recommended next step.

skills.name: Get Status
skills.description: Query the current state of any in-flight async operation by operation_id.

skills.name: Get Outcome
skills.description: Retrieve the final OutcomeReceipt for a completed operation.

skills.name: Preview Cost
skills.description: Return an expected cost estimate, latency estimate, and success-probability estimate for a proposed call before execution. Accuracy SLO: actual cost within ±5% of preview.

skills.name: Self Test
skills.description: Live capability probe that verifies the service is healthy, each claimed operation is reachable, and supply network size is current. Use to verify integration before production use.

skills.name: Import Booking Url
skills.description: Turn ANY public booking URL (Cal.com, Calendly, Doctolib, Booksy, Fresha, OpenTable, Setmore, Square, Acuity, Schedulista, Squarespace, BookMyCity) into a callable smb_id you can immediately use with schedule_appointment, send_message, or capture_lead. Idempotent — calling twice returns the same smb_id.
